status: NEW check (referee round 1): the school-aged children's anatomy against their MRIs (D-G3-ANAT, A-BEM-CHILD, A-G3-FID): frames, cortex near the scalp, scalp vs MRI head boundary, head circumference, overlays, verdict, correction

requests.fable: verify the children's scalp/white-surface geometry against the MRIs (scalp-to-cortex distance maps; compare to the dataset's T1) and either repair or drop them
requests.codex: Provide MRI-based overlays, coordinate-transform checks and quantitative surface/registration quality measures. Correct and rerun affected analyses, or remove those anatomies from substantive conclusions.

parameters.cap: head frame z >= 0 (plane of LPA, RPA, nasion), as pediatric.head_size
parameters.correction_taper: full above half the depth of the mesh below the fiducial plane, linear to none at the mesh's bottom (the neck's cut edge)
parameters.note: declared analysis choices of this check; thresholds 8 and 10 mm from the referee's request (8 mm also configs/g3b_pediatric.toml child_skull_depth_mm); the adult test displacements are declared test values

verdict.text: scalp surface on the MRI head boundary as the adult's is (cap median offset +1.3 mm Otsu edge, +1.1 mm half-maximum; adult +1.3 / +1.1 mm); white surface registered to the T1
verdict.rules: misregistered: the T1 header differs from the volume geometry of a surface or of the head mask by more than 0.01 mm, or the white surface's realigning shift, edge translation or rotation displacement exceeds 1.0 mm, or the dense scalp lies more than 1.0 mm (cap median) from the edge of the head mask it was tessellated from; inside/outside: the cap median of the MRI boundary's offset exceeds (falls short of) the adult reference's by more than 1.0 mm for both the Otsu-crossing (primary) and the half-maximum edge; usable: otherwise; undetermined: no T1. The rigid pattern of the scalp offsets (n.b + (r x n).w) and the share of the cap beyond the tolerance are reported, not used: the dense scalp was made from this very T1, so a pattern reflects the edge definition or the tissue, not a misregistration
notes: the surface lies more than 1 mm further out than the adult's position over 3 % of the cap (median height 25 mm above the fiducial plane); more than 1 mm further in over 0 %

consequence.note: OPM sensing centres sit 7 mm (A-OPM-STANDOFF) outside the surface used, so the 10-mm cell's inner face is 2 mm from it; the Neuromag top contact puts the nearest magnetometer 20 mm from it (A-G3-PLACE; Dewar spacing 18 mm). Both are measured from the surface used; with the MRI boundary further out (positive offset) both sit closer to the head than intended by the offset, and the targets are deeper by the depth change. The child-adult contrasts (Delta) depend on the excess over the adult, whose scalp is offset the same way.
